title: Hah Kumura
body:
Hah Kumura is duck cooked with kumura, ash gourd (white gourd). The duck, usually a local duck, is cooked first, then the ash gourd is added and simmered until it turns translucent and absorbs the gravy.

How it is made and served

This is the classic duck dish of Magh Bihu feasts. It is served with rice, and the soft ash gourd is eaten with the duck gravy.
